name: sentryrelay
description: Out-of-band 2FA, Email OTP, Magic-Link, dedicated US SMS DID, and Cloud KMS TOTP relay for autonomous AI browser agents.

interface.shortDescription: Unattended 2FA, OTP & TOTP relay for agents
interface.longDescription: Eliminate 2FA walls in headless browsers and coding agents. Bundles the Sentry Relay MCP server (stdio + hosted /api/mcp), 3 agent skills (core, browser 2FA, multi-client agency forwarding), and the 2FA integration architect subagent.
defaultPrompt: Wire Sentry Relay into this Playwright or Stagehand login script to resolve Email/SMS 2FA in <200ms
Add Browser Use 2FA actions (wait_for_2fa_code and get_totp_token) using sentryrelay-sdk
Set up multi-client 60-second Gmail forwarding and scoped API keys for our n8n/Apify workflows
